name: 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion: SPY Peak Lag & Drawdown
description: Analyzes each 2s/10s yield curve inversion event (T10Y2Y crosses below 0). For each inversion, computes the subsequent S&P 500 (SPY) forward peak, the calendar-day lag from inversion to that peak, and the maximum drawdown from peak. Uses FRED T10Y2Y spread and SPY price data. Forward window: 756 trading days (~3 years).
source:
# --- 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → SPY Peak & Drawdown ---
# Each inversion (T10Y2Y < 0) is detected. For each event we compute:
#   1. Forward SPY peak (highest close in next 756 trading days)
#   2. Calendar days from inversion start to that peak
#   3. Max drawdown from peak (lowest close after peak within window)

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# 10Y-2Y spread from FRED (forward-filled for daily alignment)
spread_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="T10Y2Y")
spread = ffill(spread_raw.result)

# --- Inversion Detection ---
inv_start = crossunder(spread, 0.0)
inv_end = crossover(spread, 0.0)
in_inversion = hold_until(inv_start, inv_end)

# --- Forward-Looking Metrics (lead-based) ---
# Forward peak: max close over next 756 trading days
# We build this by leading close and taking rolling max
fwd_1 = close << 1
fwd_peak = agg(fwd_1, 756, AggregationType.Max)

# Forward trough: min close over next 756 trading days
fwd_trough = agg(fwd_1, 756, AggregationType.Min)

# Max drawdown from forward peak = (trough - peak) / peak
# Note: trough may occur before peak in the window, so this is conservative
fwd_dd = (fwd_trough - fwd_peak) / fwd_peak

# Days to peak: highestbars gives negative offset (bars ago) on the CURRENT window
# We need forward bars to peak. Use lead: for each bar, how many bars forward
# is the highest close? highestbars on the lead-shifted series gives this.
# highestbars(src, N) returns negative int = how many bars ago the max occurred
# On fwd_1 (1-bar lead), highestbars gives the offset within the forward window
bars_to_peak = highestbars(fwd_1, 756) * -1
# Convert trading days to calendar days (~365/252 ratio)
cal_days_to_peak = round(bars_to_peak * 365 / 252)

# Peak timestamp: shift current timestamp forward by cal_days_to_peak
# Use datetime_diff in reverse: peak_ts = ts + lag
# Simpler: capture the peak timestamp directly
# peak_ts = valuewhen at the peak bar — but we can't do that per-event easily
# Instead, we'll report the lag in calendar days and the peak price

# --- Capture at Each Inversion Start ---
inv_ts = where(inv_start, ts)
inv_spy = where(inv_start, close)
inv_spread = where(inv_start, spread)
inv_fwd_peak = where(inv_start, fwd_peak)
inv_fwd_trough = where(inv_start, fwd_trough)
inv_fwd_dd = where(inv_start, fwd_dd)
inv_lag_days = where(inv_start, cal_days_to_peak)

# --- Chart 1: 2s/10s Spread with Inversion Shading ---
inv_band_flag = nz(where(in_inversion, 1.0), 0.0)

xy_lines(
    title='When Does the Yield Curve Invert?',
    y_axis_label='Spread (%)',
    category='Yield Curve Inversions',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2s/10s Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, spread, inv_band_flag)

# --- Chart 2: Drawdown Bars per Inversion Event ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='How Bad Does It Get After Inversion?',
    y_axis_label='Max Drawdown',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category='Yield Curve Inversions',
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(inv_fwd_dd, inv_ts)

# --- Summary Table: Per-Event Detail ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Yield Curve Inversions',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Each Inversion: Peak Lag & Drawdown',
        row_size=1, col_size=6,
        col_headers=['Inversion Date', 'SPY at Start', 'Fwd Peak', 'Days to Peak', 'Fwd Trough', 'Max Drawdown'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_color_map={"Error": ["NEGATIVE"]})
        ]
    )
)(inv_ts, inv_spy, inv_fwd_peak, inv_lag_days, inv_fwd_trough, inv_fwd_dd)

# --- Event Markers on Each Inversion ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Yield Curve Inversion',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='2s/10s Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Days to SPY Peak', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(inv_spread, inv_spy, inv_lag_days, inv_start)
